cap_note: Documented quality bound. SKILL.md Key Principle #4: 'Know when to stop: 50%+ FP rate means you've gone too generic.' METHODOLOGY.md 'Security audit triage' row: acceptable FP rate <50%. verify_variants.main defaults fp_rate_cap to 0.5. The gate's value-prop is to BLOCK a pattern whose FP rate exceeds the cap.
oracle_rule: Hand-derived from the documented contract, NOT from verify_variants.py output. FP gate: FP rate > cap => FAIL (pattern generalized too far); FP rate <= cap => PASS. CRITICAL: sampled_fp absent on a real match set => the gate has NO evidence the FP rate is under cap, so per harness-pattern.md ('skipped checks ... don't masquerade as passes') the correct verdict is UNVERIFIED/non-PASS, NOT a bare PASS. Baseline gate: Level-0 pattern must match seed_file:seed_line => match present => PASS; seed line/file mismatch => FAIL.

fp_gate_scenarios.note: FP rate 150/200 = 75% > 50% cap. Documented contract: pattern generalized too far, gate MUST fail. This is the gate delivering its value-prop.
FP rate 50/100 = 50% == cap (<= cap). Boundary: 'exceeds ~50%' means strictly greater; 50% is still acceptable. Oracle PASS.
FP rate 10/100 = 10% < 50% cap. Within acceptable bound. Oracle PASS.

THE WAVE-1 BUG. A pattern matching 5000 lines with NO FP sample. The gate has zero evidence the FP rate is under cap. Documented harness principle (harness-pattern.md sec.2): 'never launders verdicts up the stack: skipped checks report skipped + reason and dont masquerade as passes.' Correct verdict is UNVERIFIED/non-PASS. The current check_fp_gate returns a bare passed=True ('gate informational only') => INERT GATE. A bare PASS here is a CONTRACT VIOLATION; UNVERIFIED is acceptable, PASS is not.

Zero matches => no false positives possible => FP rate trivially 0%. A PASS is legitimate here (vacuously within cap). This scenario guards against over-correction: the fix must NOT start failing the empty-match case.

baseline_scenarios.note: Level-0 pattern matches seed api/users.py:42 (endswith match on file, exact line). Baseline sound => PASS.
WAVE-1 SAYS THIS PART IS SOUND. Right file, wrong line (99 != 42). Seed bug not actually matched => baseline invalid => oracle FAIL. Confirms the baseline gate works.
Right line number, wrong file. Seed api/users.py never matched => oracle FAIL.
Level-0 pattern matched nothing => cannot have matched the seed => oracle FAIL.
